messages.subject: summary.hyperpar providing erroneous results
parts:
Hi, 

A few months ago I run INLA, and used pc.priors for the parameters Soak.time (random walk smoother) as seen in the file attached "rw prior". The summary.hyperpar output from this model is shown in the file attached "summary.hyperpar_FIRST"

I have not touched this model in a while, and in the meantime, I have updated INLA in my computer and also my R version. 

Recently, I run this model again, using the same pc.prior formulation,  as well as the same dataset as the first time (Just wanted to check everything is fine after the updates as I am presenting this work soon)....However, as you can see in the file attached "summary.hyperpar_SECOND", the outputs are very different, particularly in the Soak_Time, fvesselID and the range of w....

What could be causing the issue? Could it be related to the definiton of the priors? Has there been any major change in the past months? Or Am I missing something else? 

Also, when running this model now, I am getting the in the INLA verbose the following:
        
        *** WARNING *** Eigenvalue 2 of the Hessian is -14.9846 < 0
*** WARNING *** This have consequence for the accurancy of the hyperpar
*** WARNING *** Continue with a diagonal Hessian.

which I do not recall seeing before

Kind regards

Guillermo
